arms.compiled: Compiler v3: rules 1-5 resolved in code and written as facts (task.facts_header_v3): rules 1-3 as in v2; rule 4 stale_price from the price-change decisions in force; rule 5 needs_approval resolved to 'does not apply' or 'applies unless a support note approves it' (old refund, no approval_id on the line). The model reads only the support notes: whether a finance note approves that refund (D-106) and whether a dispute on this invoice is open (D-107). Same system prompt as runs e and g (8a009618...).

baselines.frontier: declared lane, not anchored: headless Claude Code (relay_nosana/payouts/claude_code.py, Phase 1's lane, the owner's login, no API credits) on the compiled-arm input of each of the 200 items, same schema; run_1b frontier. Its score is the frontier column; the bar stays absolute
baselines.rules_only: code alone, no model: rules 1-5 over the structured fields, notes unread (data.truth_rules_only). Scored on the same 200 items; by construction it is right on every item the notes don't change: 164/200
baselines.rules_regex: code alone, no model: rules 1-5 plus a keyword/regex reading of the notes (data.truth_rules_regex: a finance note naming the refund's order with an approval word approves it; the latest note naming this invoice with a dispute word holds it, a withdrawn/closed word releases it). keywords_naive, reported beside it, drops the sender, order and invoice checks

cap_scope: USD on Nosana, all of Phase 1c from settled credits 3.536; $0.203 spent before this run
caveat: synthetic notes from our own templates: rules + a regex reading of the notes scores 200/200 on these items with no model. A pass shows the model can do what template-aware code does on the notes, not judgment code lacks

cost_estimate_usd.basis: run g's batch on 6000 Ada: 427 s listed to finished, $0.076 (32B AWQ, 200 lines). Markets cost $0.36-0.82/h; a post reserves 1 hour
cost_estimate_usd.expected: 0.08-0.25 for the batch and the re-run
cost_estimate_usd.worst_case: bounded by the cap: Budget.check refuses any post that could pass $2.00

expectation: compiled v3 >= 189/200 clears the bar; below that, stop and report.
jobs: one batch (200 compiled-v3 lines), then a re-run (33 lines) on a second node

judgment.caveat: synthetic: the notes come from our own templates, so a parser written against them could decode them. They stand in for text a code-only rule set does not read
judgment.changes: finance_approval, dispute_open: approve an old refund finance approved in a note; hold a payout with an open dispute on its invoice (reason disputed)
judgment.what: free-text support notes (from finance, support, sellers or buyers) and two policies, D-106 (which notes count as refund approval) and D-107 (open vs withdrawn disputes). The model must read who wrote a note, which order or invoice it names, and whether a dispute is still open

label_inputs: data.truth_1e: seller_id vs seller-hold decisions; invoice_id vs the seller's paid invoices; amount vs the sum of line totals; each sale line's sku, sale_date and unit price vs the price-change decisions; each refund line's order_date (> 30 days before the payout date) and approval_id; the rule priority; and each support note's hidden intent (never shown to the model). Amount thresholds ($500, $5,000) set the lane and the re-run, never the label
market: chosen at post time: the cheapest 48 GB+ premium market (6000 Ada, A6000, A40, A100 40GB, A100 80GB) whose queue on Solana has a node waiting; the batch is posted to that node. Recorded in state.market_chosen. If no node is waiting anywhere, nothing is posted
no_tuning: compiler v3 was written from the rules; it was tested on run h's fresh pool and hand-built cases, never run on run g's items
nodes: known-good node list per market from measured outcomes (relay_nosana/nosana/nodes.py), open market as fallback; in-container deadline 45 min
plan: run e's plan (Phase 1 label mix x7, 210-payout pool, NOTE_PLAN_1E) on a fresh seed; 200 drawn; payouts identical to run b's or run e's excluded
posting: not posted; requires the owner's explicit approval
raw: not posted (run b measured raw vs compiled)
rerun_policy: a second node waiting in any 48 GB+ premium market; if none runs it within 30 min of the batch finishing, receipts carry spot_check.action = pending_rerun and the gate holds those payouts until it runs
result_size: each shard's result ~140 KB (run b: 82.8 KB for 120 rows), under one 256 KiB IPFS block
routing: compiled arm if its CI lower bound >= 0.90, else human review for payouts > $500
scoring: exact match of {decision, reason_code} against data.truth(); per arm over all 200 payouts, Wilson 95% CI; also the > $500 subset; paired discordant counts with an exact two-sided binomial (sign) test
seed_fresh: 20261113 was never used (20261109 P1, 20261110 b, 20261111 c, 20261112 e/g); payouts identical to run b's or run e's are excluded
why: Run g (32B, compiler v2) missed the bar 185/200; 11 of 15 errors were rules 4-5, which are code-checkable. Run h moves rules 4-5 into code (compiler v3) so the model only reads the notes, on a fresh seed, same model and bar.
